title: How do I book a villa with Sunsational Tobago?
content: Open the villa's page, choose a room configuration and pick free dates on the live availability calendar. You'll see your full price, including any seasonal rate or current promotion, before you send anything. Instant Book villas confirm immediately; for the others our reservations team confirms availability with you before any payment is requested. Once confirmed, a 50 percent deposit secures the dates.

title: Are bookings confirmed instantly?
content: It depends on the property. Villas showing an Instant Book badge confirm your stay the moment you book free dates on the villa page, and your invoice arrives by email straight away. For every other villa, your request goes through a short approval step so our team can verify availability and property details before confirming, which usually takes less than one business day. Either way, each villa page shows live availability, so you can see which dates are free before you ask.

title: What payment methods do you accept?
content: Payments are made by bank transfer to our TTD or USD Scotiabank accounts, or our Republic Bank TTD account. After transferring, email a photo of your payment receipt so our team can verify and confirm it against your booking.

title: How much deposit is required, and when is the balance due?
content: A 50 percent deposit is required within 72 hours of your reservation being confirmed to secure the dates. The remaining balance is due 21 days before arrival. Reservations made within 21 days of arrival require full payment upfront.

title: What happens if I do not pay the deposit in time?
content: If the deposit is not received within 72 hours of confirmation, the tentative reservation is released so the dates can be offered to other guests.

title: What is the damage deposit and how do I get it back?
content: The damage deposit is equal to one night's accommodation rate for your selected property and room configuration. It is refunded within five working days of check-out once the property has been inspected, provided no damage or additional cleaning is required.

title: What is your cancellation policy?
content: Sunsational Tobago operates a no-refund cancellation policy. If your plans change, we offer six months to rebook the same accommodation, or in some cases a different property, at no additional charge.

title: What are your check-in and check-out times?
content: Check-in and check-out times vary by property and are confirmed with you before arrival. Early check-in and late check-out are available on request, subject to availability.

title: Can I check in early or check out late?
content: Yes, subject to availability. Early check-in before 12pm is TT$400, or TT$200 after 12pm. Late check-out before 2pm is TT$200, or TT$400 after 2pm.

title: How do I get into the property when I arrive?
content: Several of our villas sit inside gated communities. Once your booking is confirmed, we send full directions and ask you to call our team or housekeeper when you reach the gate or property so we can let you in and complete check-in.

title: Can I add celebration décor, breakfast or other extras?
content: Yes. Celebration décor is available for TT$400. Breakfast can be arranged on request, with a menu provided. Grocery delivery is coming soon. Let us know what you would like when you submit your enquiry or reservation form.

title: Are pets allowed?
content: Pets are not permitted unless approved by management in writing prior to arrival.

title: Can I host an event or party at the villa?
content: This varies by property. Sugar Haven Villas and Tropicbird Townhouse allow events and parties with prior arrangement and payment at the time of booking; Twin Tides Villas and Villa Arizia do not permit events, parties or loud music. Occasion decor for birthdays and anniversaries is available at every property, please mention it in your enquiry.

title: Is smoking allowed inside the villas?
content: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside all accommodations. Where permitted, smoking should only take place in designated outdoor areas.

title: Do you manage properties for owners as well as book guests?
content: Yes. Sunsational Tobago provides full-service property management, including guest communication, housekeeping coordination, marketing and reporting. Visit our Property Management page to register your interest.

title: Which areas of Tobago are your properties in?
content: Our managed properties are in Bon Accord (Sugar Haven Villas, Twin Tides Villas and Villa Arizia) and Mason Hall (Tropicbird Townhouse), both within easy reach of Tobago's main beaches, restaurants and the A.N.R. Robinson International Airport.
